title: Tesla Stock Rises Ahead of SpaceX’s Friday IPO
title_zh: 特斯拉股价在 SpaceX 周五首次公开募股之前上涨
summary: Shares of the electric-vehicle maker were up 1.4% at $396.65 in premarket trading, while  futures were up 0.4% and  futures were down 0.1%. Investors are waiting to see if some investors will sell Tesla stock to buy SpaceX shares.
summary_zh: 这家电动汽车制造商的股价在盘前交易中上涨 1.4%，至 396.65 美元，而期货上涨 0.4%，期货下跌 0.1%。投资者正在观望一些投资者是否会出售特斯拉股票来购买 SpaceX 股票。

title: Stocks reel from a coming rate hike — and brace for a huge IPO: What to watch this week
title_zh: 股市因即将到来的加息而摇摇欲坠——并为大规模首次公开募股做好准备：本周值得关注的内容
summary: The highly anticipated SpaceX IPO, Oracle earnings, and inflation data will keep investors busy this week.
summary_zh: 备受期待的 SpaceX IPO、甲骨文财报和通胀数据将使投资者本周忙碌起来。

title: ETFs in Focus as Anthropic Eyes a Blockbuster IPO
title_zh: Anthropic 着眼于重磅 IPO，ETF 成为焦点
summary: Anthropic's potential IPO could be a blockbuster. Here's how AI and IPO-focused ETFs may benefit from one of the biggest listings in tech.
summary_zh: Anthropic 潜在的 IPO 可能会引起轰动。以下是专注于人工智能和 IPO 的 ETF 如何从科技领域最大的上市之一中受益。

title: Bill Ackman’s Pershing Square to Raise $5 Billion from IPO
title_zh: 比尔·阿克曼 (Bill Ackman) 的潘兴广场 (Pershing Square) 将通过 IPO 筹集 50 亿美元
summary: Closely followed investor Bill Ackman looks likely to raise $5 billion from the upcoming initial public offering (IPO) of his investment ​management company Pershing Square.
summary_zh: 备受关注的投资者比尔·阿克曼 (Bill Ackman) 看来可能会通过其投资管理公司潘兴广场 (Pershing Square) 即将进行的首次公开募股 (IPO) 筹集 50 亿美元。

title: Inspire Brands Picks Banks For IPO That Could Raise $2 Billion
title_zh: Inspire Brands 选择银行进行 IPO 融资 20 亿美元
summary: Roark-backed restaurant group taps JPMorgan and Bank of America, with listing possibly coming as soon as this year
summary_zh: Roark支持的餐饮集团与摩根大通和美国银行合作，最早可能于今年上市
